title: Soulcalibur II arrives on PlayStation 2
summary: In 2003, Soulcalibur II became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.

blocks.text: In 2003, Soulcalibur II became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.
In the fighting category, Soulcalibur II broadened the PlayStation 2 library and reflects the range of experiences available during the console's long commercial life.
